content: Common 2D DXF entity set: LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, SPLINE, ELLIPSE, TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, LEADER, HATCH, SOLID, TRACE, plus block INSERT with ATTRIB. DIMENSION has 30+ group codes and multiple subtypes (linear/radial/arc); HATCH has recursive boundary-path definitions; MTEXT has its own inline formatting language. INSERT is normally exploded using the referenced BLOCK geometry with transform applied; non-uniform scaling can corrupt TEXT/MTEXT/ATTRIB and curved HATCH boundaries. dxf-parser (npm) supports header, most 2D entities, layers, ltype/block tables, inserts, vports, text/some MTEXT; does not support 3DSolids or all leader types.
